name: Tomato
target: Compound serrated tomato foliage, yellow star flowers, attached round green/red fruit.

name: Bell pepper
target: Smooth entire leaves, white flowers, attached blocky green/red bell peppers.

name: Carrot
target: Dissected green carrot tops, tiny orange shoulder at mature soil crown; no pulled roots.

name: Beet
target: Broad green leaves with red petioles/veins; burgundy upper root shoulder at mature crown.

name: Radish
target: Rough lobed green leaves; small red-and-cream root shoulder at mature soil crown.
